items.criterion: A signed-in Stargazer reaches the collection with the token issued at sign-in.
items.judgment: The token issued at sign-in authorises a collection read.
items.evidence: GET of the collection answers 200 for the seeded Stargazer.

items.criterion: The catalogue holds ten thousand rows generated from the stated whole-number rule.
items.judgment: Row count and the worked row both match the rule.
items.evidence: The catalogue reports its full row count and the worked row carries its stated values.

items.criterion: A brightness-filtered page is as full as an unfiltered one while matching rows remain.
items.judgment: A filtered page carries a full page of matching rows.
items.evidence: A hundred-row request under the bound returns a hundred rows, all under the bound.

items.criterion: A page reports the count of rows matching the filter rather than the size of the catalogue.
items.evidence: The filtered page reports the matching-row total.

items.criterion: A click resolves to the brightest star inside the angular radius.
items.evidence: The resolved star is the brightest inside the radius rather than the closest.

items.criterion: A segment is stored as a pair of catalogue star ids.
items.evidence: The stored segment carries the two star ids the request named.

items.criterion: Segments are returned in the order they were added.
items.evidence: Three added segments read back in their insertion order at positions one, two and three.

items.criterion: A cursor-paged collection walk returns each sky once across an insertion.
items.judgment: The walk is stable under insertion.
items.evidence: No sky id appears on both pages after a sky is created between the requests.

items.criterion: A published link returns the drawing as it stood at publish time.
items.evidence: The published link returns its original segments after the sky gains another.

items.criterion: A replayed publish returns the first share token and creates no second record.
items.judgment: Publish is idempotent on its share key.
items.evidence: One row exists for the share key after three replays.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous publishes on one share key produce a single winner.
items.evidence: One request creates the publish, the other receives a conflict response, and one row exists.

items.criterion: The share token returned by a publish is minted by the server.
items.evidence: The returned tokens differ from the ones supplied, and the supplied share token addresses nothing.

items.criterion: A render lands in the object store at its own revision key.
items.judgment: The render exists in the bucket.
items.evidence: An object exists at the reported key.

items.criterion: A later render leaves the earlier revision in place at its own key.
items.evidence: Both revision keys exist in the bucket after a second render.

items.criterion: A second Stargazer is refused a private sky and its rendered image.
items.judgment: Ownership is enforced on the server.
items.evidence: Both requests are denied and the protected sky is unchanged.

items.criterion: A segment naming a star id outside the catalogue is refused with nothing written.
items.evidence: The request is refused and the sky carries no segment.
